provenance.author: AUD-07 review fixes (Claude)
provenance.notes: Gap rule, target side: the engine's take-profit is a market close sent when the mark is at/through the level, so a candle that opens through it fills at the open, adverse-adjusted by the slippage (same as the stop side, G-GAP-STOP-L-01). ATR 1; entry 100.02, stop 98.02, R 2, target 2 R = 104.02. Candle 282 opens at 106 (= its high, red: the first path point is the open). Exit 106 x 0.9998 = 105.9788; pnl = 5 x (105.9788 - 100.02) - 5 x (105.9788 + 100.02) x 0.0005 = 29.279003. The legacy backtest books 104.02 x 0.9998: 19.385932 (-1.0 R). Found by gapprobe.py (Windows adversarial review).
